---
title: About querying data
description: Query data in TimescaleDB using standard PostgreSQL syntax and additional analytical features
products: [cloud, mst, self_hosted]
---

import * as C from "@constants";

Querying data in {C.TIMESCALE_DB} works just like querying data in {C.PG}. You
can reuse your existing queries if you're moving from another {C.PG}
database.

{C.TIMESCALE_DB} also provides some additional features to help with data analysis:

*   Use [{C.POPSQL}](/build/data-management/run-queries-from-tiger-console) to work on data with centralized SQL queries, interactive visuals and real-time collaboration
*   The [`SkipScan`](../skipscan) feature speeds up `DISTINCT` queries
*   [Hyperfunctions](/build/data-management/hyperfunctions) improve the experience of writing many data
    analysis queries
*   [Function pipelines](/build/data-management/hyperfunctions/function-pipelines) bring functional programming to SQL queries,
    making it easier to perform consecutive transformations of data
